scope: Actual source-built Windows Horizon 26.3 client, offscreen Vulkan1280x720; six accepted scratch worlds, twelve clean exits, structures-disabled ABBA plus two structures-enabled UI worlds. No whole-client speedup claim.

source.versionIdentitySource: Verified copied package metadata manifests and archived horizon-mod.toml; engine revision also matches both actual stage receipts. Repository default config is not the tested stage identity.

storageHost.scope: Read-only hardware observation; QA runtime copies and all new scratch data use C NVMe. Other tasks were left running.

hostLoadObservation.scope: Read-only observation during candidate structures-v2. These are outside this test bin root and were left running. CPU/GPU/storage contention prevents a controlled speed claim.

oldQaStop.emptyArrayNormalizationNote: Null entries from PowerShell empty-member enumeration were filtered; the original receipt remains unchanged and hashed.

abba.scope: Real integrated native client: supplied seed8675309 spectator spawn, structures disabled, offscreen1280x720, FPS cap60. Cold destination residence, server-stage quiet and renderer readiness are distinct end-to-end observations; no pure chunk-generation throughput claim.

counterSemantics.generated_chunks: Received and disk-loaded columns too; used only as a readiness change signal, never as a fresh-generation count
counterSemantics.server_generation.caches: Host pipeline census, not TerraForged tile/river counts
counterSemantics.serverQuiet: All server stages zero except protos; first observation gated on requested residence and changed/full view
counterSemantics.viewReady: Two fresh quiet server samples and client/render readiness, stable resident counts for at least one second

stabilityStress.scope: Untimed cancellation/unload stress after all primary speed samples

abba.speedConclusion: Mixed end-to-end destination waits; no consistent whole-client speedup established. Candidate initial-launch/player-control observations were slower in both processes. Only two observations per variant; other host CPU/GPU/storage load was uncontrolled.

baseline.visualReview: Seven images accepted for above-ground rendering smoke
baseline.visibleStructureObservation: Desert village buildings are visible in the reopened distant view; placement completeness and correctness are not established

stability.savedVectorComparison: Fixture compares complete stored vectors with actual native factory and requires a different vanilla vector; diagnostic fingerprints are retained here.
stability.rapidTeleportCancellationUnloadStress: Six teleports on candidate ABBA run2, then drained server/client/render queues, save/reopen and exact saved biome checks passed. Stress excluded from speed summaries.
stability.memoryConclusion: Windows PeakWorkingSetSize recorded per ABBA process; no long-soak leak claim. Candidate run2 includes extra stress and is not a matched memory workload.
